notes: Independently read all 26 eligible production JS/TS-family files (including copy-a2ui.d.mts, the copy script, A2UI browser source and rolldown build config) plus package.json and openclaw.plugin.json. All 43 plugin files are explicitly partitioned; no ambiguous test-only helper exclusion was needed.

All production local imports stay within extensions/canvas. runtime-api.ts reexports Canvas-owned implementations and composite types, not direct SDK aliases. No additional plugin-owned/shared shipped source lies beyond the plugin root. The package asset build command references core scripts/tsx.mjs and scripts/bundle-a2ui.mts as build tooling, not imported shipped plugin source; generated bundle output named in package metadata is not present in the pinned plugin tree.

Public module spellings and original exported names were checked against root package.json exports and src/plugin-sdk facades. readBoolean, readRecord, readString, and fsRoot resolve to asBoolean, asOptionalRecord, readStringValue, and root respectively. No SDK module suffix normalization was needed.

definePluginEntry supplies OpenClawPluginApi to register callbacks via OpenClawPluginDefinition.register. api.runtime.nodes is propagated unchanged into the presenter and typed PluginRuntime["nodes"]. Explicit public indexed types contribute runtime.nodes, runtime.nodes.list, api.registerWidgetPresenter and api.registerBoardWidgetContentKind; ReturnType node descriptors do not extend those public paths.

Browser bootstrap globalThis.openclaw aliases are the widget board action bridge (state.emit/prompt.send), not the native OpenClawPluginApi or PluginRuntime. host.jsx #api/globalThis.openclawA2UI is a plugin-owned renderer object. Neither produces API/runtime findings.

defaultRuntime is an SDK-exported RuntimeEnv object, so direct writeJson/log calls attach call to that export and do not invent PluginRuntime paths. getNodesTheme().ok and fsRoot() filesystem handles are SDK return values; their members are not native API/runtime members or additional direct SDK-export calls. The direct typeof fsRoot type reference makes only security-runtime#root mixed.

Known SDK helpers are boundary dependencies only; their internal member consumption is not inferred. Dynamic SDK imports are immediately destructured and contribute only their named exports, without synthetic namespace-star dependencies.

No on/registerHook registrations occur. Manifest identities are limited to skills and contracts.tools; doctor/config migration metadata, configSchema, categories and runtime node/CLI descriptors are not manifest contracts under the frozen rules. No genuinely unresolved SDK/API/runtime construct remained.
